name: 661. Replicate and Hugging Face image streams refuse more than one image (image stream count) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-8077 regression, contract C4 and C5. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream. The replicate and huggingface image streams relay the images under one index and end on a frame that carries one image and no usage.output_images, so a streamed request for more than one image would be billed as one while the vendor makes and bills n. Core now refuses a streamed image generation or edit asking for more than one image (n, or num_images, number_of_images or num_outputs in extra params) on every provider that does not declare that its stream relays and counts every image (schemas.ImageStreamCounter; byteplus does). Pinned, on JSON /v1/images/generations and multipart /v1/images/edits: a replicate and a huggingface (fal-ai) generation stream with n above 1, a replicate edit stream with the form field n=2, and a huggingface edit stream with the extra form field num_images=2 are each answered 400 caller_unsupported_parameter with error.param naming the field, and /__wire shows no request reached the fixture. core/imagestreamcount_test.go pins the other vendor names and values.

item.name: [EXPECT-400] replicate/black-forest-labs/flux-schnell /v1/images/generations stream with n=2 is refused naming n, before any prediction is created (image stream count)

exec: if (pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixture') !== '1') {
pm.execution.skipRequest();
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl') + '/__reset', method: 'POST' }, function (err, res) {
pm.test('image stream count setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null);
pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200);
var FX = pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl');
// wire: the requests that reached the fixture, bytes as they arrived.

function wire(cb) { pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__wire', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.test('the fixture answered /__wire', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); }); cb(res.json().data[0].calls); }); }
pm.test('the client gets 400', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(400); });
var body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('error_type is caller_unsupported_parameter', function () { pm.expect(body.extra_fields && body.extra_fields.error_type, pm.response.text()).to.equal('caller_unsupported_parameter'); });
pm.test('error.param names n', function () { pm.expect(body.error && body.error.param, pm.response.text()).to.equal('n'); });

pm.test('the message says n must be 1 with stream', function () { pm.expect(body.error && body.error.message, pm.response.text()).to.include('n must be 1 when stream is true').and.to.include('got n=2'); });
wire(function (calls) { pm.test('no upstream call was made', function () { pm.expect(calls, JSON.stringify(calls)).to.have.length(0); }); });
